name: mapsize-min
description: Map Size: the smallest map: Modify Map Bounds ticked, the right edge's < and the top edge's v clicked 10 times each (4 tiles a click: 64 stops at 32, the dialog's Full label shows 32 x 32 and the arrows do nothing beyond); Studio's resize_map right -32, top -32 (its minimum is 32 as well). The start (0, -256) is on the new right edge (x 0): the World Editor removes it and its save makes one at a random place (ignored: the start's x, y, hit points and mana and the w3i's player start), Studio moves it into the camera bounds (its eval checks the start location and the w3i's start lie inside them; the same in mapsize-cut-right-start, mapsize-cut-bottom-start, mapsize-start-off)

steps.eval: await w3.editors.saveAll(); const units = JSON.parse(await w3.workspace.readText('map/war3mapUnits.doo.json')).units; const w3i = JSON.parse(await w3.workspace.readText('map/war3map.w3i.json')); const b = w3i.cameraBounds; const xs = [b[0], b[2], b[4], b[6]], ys = [b[1], b[3], b[5], b[7]]; const inside = (p) => p[0] >= Math.min(...xs) && p[0] <= Math.max(...xs) && p[1] >= Math.min(...ys) && p[1] <= Math.max(...ys); if (units.length !== 1 || units[0].id !== 'sloc' || !inside(units[0].position) || !inside(w3i.players[0].start)) throw new Error(`after the resize the start is not one start location inside the camera bounds ${b}: units ${JSON.stringify(units.map((u) => [u.id, u.position]))}, the w3i's start ${w3i.players[0].start}`);

name: mapsize-max-width
description: Map Size: the widest map: the right edge's > clicked 56 times (the map stops at 32256 after 55, a coordinate limit; the 56th click moves the playable edge out instead, the right border 6 to 2), then the left edge's outward arrow (463,333) 60 times (stops at 480 x 64 after 49, map -29184 to 32256, playable 472); Studio refuses growth past ±32256 (resize.ts coordProblem; project rule 2026-11-17), so its resize_map asks for the editor's result: right 220, left 196, border 6 2 4 8

name: mapsize-limit-left
description: Map Size at the coordinate limit on the left: 56 clicks out, the map stops at -32256 after 55, the 56th moves the playable edge (left border 6 to 2). Studio refuses growth past ±32256 (resize.ts coordProblem), so its resize_map asks for that: left 220, border 2 6 4 8

name: mapsize-limit-top
description: Map Size at the coordinate limit on top: 56 clicks out, the map stops at 32256 after 55, the 56th moves the playable edge (top border 8 to 4). Studio refuses growth past ±32256 (resize.ts coordProblem), so its resize_map asks for that: top 220, border 6 6 4 4

name: mapsize-limit-bottom
description: Map Size at the coordinate limit at the bottom: 56 clicks out, the map stops at -32256 after 55, the 56th moves the playable edge (bottom border 4 to 0). Studio refuses growth past ±32256 (resize.ts coordProblem), so its resize_map asks for that: bottom 220, border 6 6 0 8

name: mapsize-limit-bottom57
description: Map Size past the coordinate limit at the bottom: 57 clicks out, the 57th does nothing (the bottom border is 0 already). Studio refuses growth past ±32256 (resize.ts coordProblem), so its resize_map asks for that: bottom 220, border 6 6 0 8

name: mapsize-ns-limit-right
description: Map Size past the coordinate limit on a 96 x 64 map: the right edge's > 54 times, the map stops at 32256 after 51 (204 tiles), the 52nd takes the right border from 6 to 2, the 53rd to 0, the 54th does nothing (playable 294). Studio refuses growth past ±32256 (resize.ts coordProblem), so its resize_map asks for that: right 204, border 6 0 4 8
